pages.title: BeesPuzzle
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Slide hives around the board in BeesPuzzle so the bees can collect the tiles. Look at how each hive can move and work out how to clear the more crowded arrangements.

pages.title: Goose Cup
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Pick a country and juggle a football in Goose Cup. Each touch adds points to your team's shared total, so keep the ball in the air to help your country climb the standings.

pages.title: Clicker Hero
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Tap to defeat monsters in Clicker Hero and spend the gold on heroes who attack automatically. Upgrade your team for tougher enemies and check what the heroes earned when you return.

pages.title: Tetro Merge
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Drop shaped blocks into the pile in Tetro Merge. Matching shapes fuse when they touch, so account for the way each piece bounces and leave room for the larger blocks you create.

pages.title: Avatar World Secrets
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Design rooms and dress a family of avatars in Avatar World Secrets. Place objects around the space and try out interactions with the characters as you make up your own scenes.

pages.title: Draw To Smash Zombie
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Draw an object that can knock out the zombies in Draw To Smash Zombie. Look at where they're standing and sketch a shape that will reach them once it comes into play.

pages.title: Worm: Apple Quest
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Guide a worm toward the Golden Apple in Worm: Apple Quest. Eating apples changes its length, so work out how to use the extra reach to cross gaps and navigate tight spaces.

pages.title: Fierce Battle Breakout
pages.creator: yiyuan
pages.description: Fight for survival through a series of 3D challenges in Fierce Battle Breakout. Keep moving as hostile forces close in and choose when to fight so you can make it past the next danger.

pages.title: Bear vs Humans
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Ride a log with squirrels in Bear vs Humans and rampage through the forest. Smash objects around campsites, roar to frighten people, and use the squirrels as projectiles when you want to cause more trouble.

pages.title: The Office Escape
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Fight your way out of a guarded workplace in The Office Escape. Shoot enemies and break through doors, paying attention to the objects you need to act on to open a path.

pages.title: Woodoku Block Puzzle
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Fit wooden pieces onto a grid in Woodoku Block Puzzle. Think about where new shapes can go before the board fills and switch between four modes for different ways to play.

pages.title: Sea Battle Admiral
pages.creator: DRA
pages.description: Place a fleet on your grid and search for hidden ships in Sea Battle Admiral. Track hits and misses to narrow down the enemy positions before the opposing fleet finds yours.

pages.title: Bubiloons
pages.creator: Tap Tap Tales
pages.description: Explore the world of the Bubiloons, a group of unicorn-like animals with a knack for bubbles. Tap or swipe the highlighted objects to discover what each scene has to show you.

pages.title: Emilys Hotel Solitaire
pages.creator: Rainbow Games
pages.description: Play hands of solitaire with Emily in Emilys Hotel Solitaire. Work through the card layouts on a tropical island and help her pursue her grandfather's dream of building a hotel there.

pages.title: Pet Simulator
pages.creator: PivDev
pages.description: Catch animals and run a pet store in Pet Simulator. Grow food and feed the animals as you build up the business, keeping an eye on what visiting customers need.

pages.title: Card Shuffle Sort
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Rearrange the cards in Card Shuffle Sort to get each color together. Look at what can move next before shifting a pile, especially when more colors begin to share the board.

pages.title: Idle Desert Life
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Build a raft and rescue stranded people in Idle Desert Life. Expand the crew, visit new land and use what you gather to start rebuilding a community from the ground up.

pages.title: Mother's Day Float Connect
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Link pairs of matching holiday objects in Mother's Day Float Connect. Connections can make at most two right-angle turns, and some layouts shift the tiles after each match, opening different routes.

pages.title: Snow Fun
pages.creator: Dorfer Games OU
pages.description: Push snow into a growing roll in Snow Fun. Earn money from your work and spend it on a better shovel so you can clear areas faster and open up new places to work.

pages.title: Koxo.io
pages.creator: LapaMauve
pages.description: Swing a weighted ball around your character in Koxo.io. Move around the arena and use broad mouse movements to build momentum with the chain before it reaches an opponent.

pages.title: Sweet Shop 3D
pages.creator: Devshifu Studio
pages.description: Open a candy business in Sweet Shop 3D and serve treats to customers. Grow supplies in the garden, spend your earnings on more shop space and hire workers to handle the extra work.

pages.title: Help Me: Time Travel Adventure
pages.creator: Brosco Games
pages.description: Choose how to get the hero out of trouble in Help Me: Time Travel Adventure. Each scene offers a decision, and you'll have to judge which action can actually lead to a rescue.

pages.title: Jumping Together
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Help a group of puppies reach the exit in Jumping Together. Use the other pups to reach spots one puppy can't jump to by itself and solve 24 levels on the way home.

pages.title: Laser Cannon 2
pages.creator: HyperCarrot
pages.description: Use a laser cannon to clear every monster in Laser Cannon 2. Move the cannon and try charged shots, or use the objects in each level to set up indirect hits.

pages.title: Sniper Champion 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Shoot targets for points in Sniper Champion 3D. Each level gives you a minute to score over 1,000, and more accurate shooting can earn you a better star rating.

pages.title: Super Slope Game
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Roll a ball down a 3D course in Super Slope Game. Steer around obstacles as you build speed and watch the track ahead to see how far you can get before falling.

pages.title: Time Control
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Keep the red ball traveling between two scoring points in Time Control. Adjust its pace when rotating squares cross the path and time each pass to get through an opening.

pages.title: City War 3D
pages.creator: NikSan Tech
pages.description: Send your troops to capture opposing territory in City War 3D. Watch how the balance of forces changes and choose where to commit your units as the fight plays out in real time.

pages.title: Letter Fit
pages.creator: Nevar Games
pages.description: Type letters to drop them into a container in Letter Fit. Think about the shape of each character and the space it will leave, then get the whole set to fit inside.

pages.title: Speed Boat Extreme Racing
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Race speedboats on six courses in Speed Boat Extreme Racing. Try five boats and learn how they turn at speed, or leave the course behind to explore the free-driving area.

pages.title: Dot Rescue
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Keep a dot moving around a circle in Dot Rescue. Watch the rotating shield and change course when it blocks your path, trying to avoid contact for as long as you can.

pages.title: Find Mia Party Outfits
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Search Mia's messy room for clothes and accessories in Find Mia Party Outfits. Recover the pieces she needs for the evening, then use what you found to get her dressed for the party.

pages.title: Stack Rider
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Gather balls to build up your stack in Stack Rider. Steer around obstacles that can knock balls away and keep enough in reserve to make it all the way to the finish.

pages.title: Figures
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Fit the correct shape into each opening in Figures before the spikes catch up. Look at the new pattern each round and make quick choices as the time available gets shorter.

pages.title: Draw Rider
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Sketch your wheels in Draw Rider and test them on the course. Change the shape as the terrain changes and find a design that keeps your racer moving toward the finish.

pages.title: Atari Breakout
pages.creator: Atari
pages.description: Move the paddle to bounce a ball into the bricks in Atari Breakout. Try Double, Cavity or Progressive to see how each mode changes the way you work through the blocks.

pages.title: Breakfast Prepare
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Get breakfast ready in Breakfast Prepare by filling bowls and putting together simple dishes. Decide what goes on the sandwich or how much cereal to pour as you work through each morning meal.

pages.title: Space Imposter
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Lead the little space characters across obstacle courses in Space Imposter. Time your moves to get them to each goal and work through more stages to unlock the game's achievements.

pages.title: Kingpin Goat Escape
pages.creator: GAMES4KING
pages.description: Search a series of rooms for clues in Kingpin Goat Escape. Inspect objects and solve the puzzles that stand between you and each locked door as you work toward the escape.

pages.title: Beauty Queen Coloring Book
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Color pictures of a queen in Beauty Queen Coloring Book. Pick shades for the clothes and details, then try a different palette to give the next picture its own look.

pages.title: Coach Bus Simulator
pages.creator: Inspire Game Studio
pages.description: Take passengers between cities in Coach Bus Simulator. Learn how the coach handles across different driving scenarios and follow the roads through an open map to reach each stop.

pages.title: Kawaii Jump
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Guide a purple slime up through the tiles in Kawaii Jump. Aim for solid platforms and stay away from ones that break, then unlock other animals as you keep climbing.

pages.title: Mineblox Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Connect chains of matching food in Mineblox Puzzle to earn points and money for Steve. Look for groups you can link together and think quickly as the pieces on the board change.

pages.title: Evil Nun Scary Horror Creepy Game
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Find a way out of a haunted house in Evil Nun Scary Horror Creepy Game. Search the old rooms for an escape route while staying alert to what else is inside.

pages.title: City Taxi Driving Simulator Game 2020
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Pick up passengers and drive them through the city in City Taxi Driving Simulator Game 2020. Get used to handling the cab in an open 3D world as you make your rounds.

pages.title: Princesses VS Epidemic
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Help the princesses look after their community in Princesses VS Epidemic. Equip Eliza with a mask and protective glasses before shopping for an elderly couple, then help the others with their own tasks.

pages.title: Off road 4X4 Jeep Racing Xtreme 3D
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Drive a 4x4 across rough safari and jungle terrain in Off road 4X4 Jeep Racing Xtreme 3D. Try different Jeeps and learn how to handle their power over uneven stretches of the course.

pages.title: Virus Sling
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Pull back and release to send a virus upward in Virus Sling. Work around obstacles as you bounce higher, and pick up coins to unlock other viruses for later climbs.

pages.title: Super Jump
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Hold to charge a jump and release to leap across rooftops in Super Jump. Adjust the distance to each gap, watch for obstacles and birds, and grab power-ups as you go.

pages.title: Super Sneakers Memory
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Turn over sneaker pictures to find pairs in Super Sneakers Memory. Keep track of where each design is hiding and see how few flips you need to clear all four levels.

pages.title: Sportbike Drive
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Pick a map in Sportbike Drive and take a motorcycle out for a spin. Use the rear brake to control your turns and reset the bike if you need to get back into position.

pages.title: Rage Ride
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Turn your ship to dodge asteroids in Rage Ride. Collect juice as you explore the 2D space around you, and use what you gather to unlock a different ship.

pages.title: Parking Toy Story
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Drive a toy car through a maze of scattered toys in Parking Toy Story. Find the route to the parking spot and get the car into place before the timer runs out.

pages.title: Garbage Trucks Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Choose a difficulty and assemble pictures of cartoon garbage trucks in Garbage Trucks Jigsaw. Work through twelve designs at your own pace and move each piece where it fits in the image.

pages.title: Tile Connect
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Clear the fruit board in Tile Connect by linking two identical pictures at a time. Look for routes short enough to connect a pair and use the space that opens to reach new matches.

pages.title: Santa Claus Jump
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Charge each leap in Santa Claus Jump by holding before you release. Dodge the rockets, grab candy for power, and look out for little Santas that can bring your character back.

pages.title: Castel
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Run along the castle walls in Castel, timing jumps to clear obstacles and reach stars. Keep the run going and see how your score compares with your previous attempt.

pages.title: Action Super Hero
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Collect coins as you guide the hero in Action Super Hero. Destroy enemies when you can and steer around ones that might collide with you, since each hit drains energy from the run.

pages.title: Save Color Pets
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Match three or more of the same pet in Save Color Pets. Make rows or columns to clear away the dirty sand and free the trapped animals before time runs out.

pages.title: Geometry Dash Crazy
pages.creator: crazyschoolgames
pages.description: Pick a planet and try its obstacle track in Geometry Dash Crazy. Follow the music while you time your moves, and see how far you can make it in each of the three chapters.

pages.title: Watermelon Smasher Frenzy
pages.creator: Black Sheep Games
pages.description: Smash the green watermelons as they appear in Watermelon Smasher Frenzy. Leave the red ones alone and keep reacting quickly as you try to get more hits before time runs out.

pages.title: Real Taxi Driver
pages.creator: Hitgames.org
pages.description: Drive a cab in Real Taxi Driver and use the turn signals as you make your way through the city. Use the parking brake when you need to stop or reposition the car.

pages.title: 8 Ball Pool Stars 1
pages.creator: Super Apps
pages.description: Line up shots with the cue in 8 Ball Pool Stars. Drag to aim and set up the hit, then see where the balls come to rest before planning your next shot.

pages.title: FireWorks Fever
pages.creator: Bofer Media (Twim Studio)
pages.description: Tap fireworks to set them off in FireWorks Fever. Pick up coins as you play, work toward opening new cities, and use the chests to find more levels to try.

pages.title: Math Attack
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Fire at the blocks ahead in Math Attack and keep a path open as you move. Spend your earnings on more powerful or faster shots to break through tougher blocks.

pages.title: Army Combat
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Choose a weapon and enter one of two modes in Army Combat. Switch between first-person and third-person views and use crouching, jumping and careful aim to fight through enemy positions.

pages.title: Catapultz.io
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Aim and release your catapult in Catapultz.io to hit other players. Adjust your angle after each throw and try to be the first to rack up 20 eliminations in the round.

pages.title: EG Pic Quiz
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Uncover small parts of a photo and guess what it shows in EG Pic Quiz. Try to identify it with fewer clicks, since getting the answer early earns a larger bonus.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Domesticated Animals
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Reassemble pictures of farm and household animals in Jigsaw Puzzle Domesticated Animals. Pick from 16 scenes and use the shapes and colors in each one to guide the pieces into place.

pages.title: Valentine's Day Hearty Hairstyles
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Try five heart-themed styles in Valentine's Day Hearty Hairstyles. Work through the steps for each design and see how the strands come together into a finished look for the holiday.

pages.title: Princess Tailor Shop
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Design your own outfit at the Princess Tailor Shop. Choose the materials and details for your dress, then watch the princess turn those choices into an outfit made just for you.

pages.title: Doodle God: Fantasy World of Magic
pages.creator: JoyBits
pages.description: Combine magical elements in Doodle God: Fantasy World of Magic. Experiment with pairs to discover creatures, spells and characters, then use the new discoveries to expand the fantasy world.

pages.title: Save My Moon
pages.creator: ReCorp Games
pages.description: Dodge incoming asteroids in Save My Moon and gather coins for store upgrades. Try different heroes and abilities to extend your run, and pick up useful objects as you go.

pages.title: Feed The Monster
pages.creator: FurEye Games
pages.description: Aim food at the hungry creature in Feed The Monster. Adjust your throws to land the food where the monster can eat it and learn from where each toss ends up.

pages.title: Blackjack Master
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Play against the dealer in Blackjack Master. Decide when to draw another card or stand, trying to beat the dealer's total or reach 21 without going over.

pages.title: Little Big Runners
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Run from the giant monster in Little Big Runners. Change between large and small forms to get past boxes, spikes and smaller monsters as they interrupt the route ahead.

pages.title: Dead City
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Shoot the zombies closing in through the streets of Dead City. Pick targets quickly and clear the advancing crowd to stay alive as long as you can.

pages.title: Moorhuhn Football
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Time your kicks in Moorhuhn Football so the ball goes into the net. Watch the approach of each ball and try to make better use of the next shot if you miss.

pages.title: Princess Fashion Tailor
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Make a dress for a fashion contest in Princess Fashion Tailor. Choose a shape, fabric and color for the princess, then bring the pieces together into a look for the competition.

pages.title: Hell Footy
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Take on monsters in a football match in Hell Footy. Aim your shots and use the ball to defeat the creatures as you try to run up the score.

pages.title: FGP Sudoku
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Fill the blank cells in FGP Sudoku so each row, column and box contains the required digits. Use the numbers already given to eliminate possibilities until the grid is complete.
